subject: Sequenced demo ops, qualification + reschedule request
messages:
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@clearcart.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:23:00 -0800
Subject: Interested in a quick live walkthrough — self-serve signup

Hi Jordan,

We signed up for Redwood's self-serve yesterday and started poking at the API. We're interested in a short walkthrough to understand how to move from the sandbox to a short pilot. Quick context: we're ClearCart (checkout optimization for DTC brands) — primary use case is real-time product suggestion generation and reranking for checkout flows.

Rough traffic: ~1.2M inference requests / month today, spikes up to ~35 req/s during peak events. Average response length ~120 tokens; typical session includes 3–4 calls. Pilot timeline: aim to be live in ~6–8 weeks.

Questions before we book:
- Can you handle our peak concurrency and keep p95 latency < 250ms?
- Do you have recommended sequence length / token budgeting tips for a reranking pipeline?
- Any gotchas for integrating with our SSO + Okta?

Can you propose a couple of slots next week? I attached a traffic snapshot export. Also, our engineering manager Diego and security lead would like to join if possible.

Thanks,
Samantha Ortiz
Head of Product, ClearCart
attachments: traffic-snapshot.csv (CSV)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@clearcart.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 12:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Interested in a quick live walkthrough — self-serve signup

Hi Samantha — thanks for the detail and the snapshot, very helpful. Quick answers up front: we routinely support peaks at your scale; typical p95 for similar reranking workloads is in the 120–220ms range depending on model choice and batching; we can talk through options. Okta SSO is supported — we'll need a short SAML exchange during onboarding.

To make the live session useful, could you confirm a few items so we tailor the demo:
- Primary inference type: generation+rerank (end-to-end) or embeddings+ANN rerank?
- Typical sequence length distribution (max tokens per request) and whether you cluster multiple items per call
- Expected concurrency for the pilot (target capacity we should reserve)
- Any hard SLA or data residency needs for the pilot

Proposed sequencing (so we can reschedule parts rather than one long session):
1) 20-min discovery (use case + traffic walkthrough)
2) 30-min tech/deployment demo (architecture, latency/cost levers, SSO)
3) optional 30-min ops/onboarding review (sandbox creds, retention, logs)

Three slots (PST) next week:
- Tue 11/23 10:00–10:50am
- Wed 11/24 2:00–2:50pm
- Thu 11/25 9:00–9:50am

I attached a short demo-readiness checklist that lists what we'd like to see pre-demo. If those three don't work, tell me Diego's availability and we'll reschedule. I'm cc'ing Ben (pilot engineering) and Monica (onboarding) who will join and own next steps.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: demo-readiness-checklist.pdf (PDF)
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@clearcart.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@clearcart.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Interested in a quick live walkthrough — self-serve signup

Thanks Jordan — appreciate the sequencing idea. Diego is available but the Wed/Thu slots overlap with another vendor call. Can we do Mon 11/29 11:00–11:30am (PST) instead? We prefer a shorter discovery first — Diego will join; our security lead asked to review the checklist ahead of time.

Extra detail on traffic after digging in: our 1.2M monthly requests translate to ~1.8M prompt tokens / month; bursty on promo days with short spikes to ~40 req/s for ~3–5 minutes. For the pilot we expect to run with 4 concurrent workers and scale to 12 if performance holds. Hope that helps.

Also, any sandbox credentials you can provision ahead of the call would speed things up.

— Samantha
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@clearcart.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 08:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Interested in a quick live walkthrough — self-serve signup

Hi Samantha — Mon 11/29 11:00–11:30am PST works. I'll block a 45-minute window on our side in case we need to extend. Ben will own sandbox provisioning and will send temporary API keys and a short folder with a sample integration script before the meeting. Monica will include SSO/SAML notes in the invite.

Follow-ups we want to prepare on our side given your traffic notes:
- I'll sketch recommended batching limits and token budgeting that keeps cost predictable while maintaining p95 latency budgets.
- Ben will pre-populate a small synthetic replay (based on your csv) so we can run a short live throughput check.

Will send calendar invite + a shared Miro/Docs link with a short mutual action plan. If Diego's security lead wants to send a short SOC2 or retention question list ahead of time, Monica will route to our security team.

Thanks — see you 11/29.
Jordan
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Sequenced demo ops, qualification + reschedule request

Quick note — I'll provision a sandbox org with read/write keys and a short sample that replays the traffic-snapshot.csv at small scale. I'll also add a paragraph in the shared doc about expected burst handling and a suggested canary configuration for the pilot. I'll create the calendar invite and include the SSO checklist.

Next steps (internal):
- Ben: provision sandbox + sample script (before 11/29)
